description: A flagship run-of-river hydroelectric development harnessing the high volumetric discharge of the Tumauini River. Featuring a reinforced concrete diversion weir, automated desilting basin, high-pressure penstock, and an advanced dual-turbine powerhouse feeding clean green energy directly into the Luzon grid. EPC design by EDCOP.
